engagements_authorization_recorded.name: engagements_authorization_recorded
engagements_authorization_recorded.value:
"engagements"."state" IN ('DISCOVERING', 'SELLER_SELECTED', 'CANCELLED')
        OR ("engagements"."authorized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "engagements"."authorized_by" IS NOT NULL AND "engagements"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

projects_source_present.name: projects_source_present
projects_source_present.value:
("projects"."source_type" = 'repository' AND "projects"."fixture_key" IS NULL)
        OR ("projects"."source_type" = 'fixture' AND "projects"."fixture_key" IS NOT NULL AND "projects"."repository_url" IS NULL)

spending_mandates_authorization_recorded.name: spending_mandates_authorization_recorded
spending_mandates_authorization_recorded.value: "spending_mandates"."status" = 'draft' OR ("spending_mandates"."authorized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "spending_mandates"."authorized_by" IS NOT NULL)

testing_results_counts_consistent.name: testing_results_counts_consistent
testing_results_counts_consistent.value:
"testing_results"."tests_total" IS NULL OR (
        "testing_results"."tests_total" >= 0 AND "testing_results"."tests_passed" >= 0 AND "testing_results"."tests_failed" >= 0 AND "testing_results"."tests_skipped" >= 0
        AND "testing_results"."tests_passed" + "testing_results"."tests_failed" + "testing_results"."tests_skipped" = "testing_results"."tests_total"
      )

wallet_ledger_entries_one_account.name: wallet_ledger_entries_one_account
wallet_ledger_entries_one_account.value: ("wallet_ledger_entries"."master_wallet_account_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("wallet_ledger_entries"."engagement_wallet_id" IS NOT NULL)
